Set key parameters:

Code 
overwrite <- FALSE
Code 
alpha <- 0.05

extinction_time <- 100 # not strictly extinction - kept here for consistency!

eps <- 0.5 # from A/B
p_i <- 0.7 # from A/B
p_r <- 0.5 # from A/B

eps_start <- eps
eps_end <- eps
eps_rate <- 5

pir_start <- p_i * p_r
# pir_end <- pir_start * 0.5
# pir_rate <- 0.04

epss <- eps_start + (eps_end - eps_start) * plogis(
  seq(-eps_rate, eps_rate, length.out = 2 * extinction_time)
)

pirs <- rep(pir_start, 2 * extinction_time)

pse <- epss * pirs

classes <- tibble(
  class = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
  weight = c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25),
  beta_1 = c(50, 50, 20, 10),
  beta_2 = c(1, 3, 10, 20),
  certain = c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)
)

iterations <- 1:10
test_times <- seq(0.5 * extinction_time, length(pse), by = 1)

grid <- expand.grid(test_time = test_times, iteration = iterations)

Set up functions for records, surveys, and effort:

Code 
simulate_class_records <- function(record_class, test_time, extinction_time, pse) {
  counts <- rpois(test_time, pse[1:test_time] * record_class$weight)

  out <- tibble(
    time = rep(seq_len(test_time), counts)
  )

  if (nrow(out) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      time = integer(),
      certainty = numeric(),
      class = character(),
      certain = logical(),
      correct = logical()
    ))
  }

  out <- out %>%
    mutate(
      certainty = rbeta(
        n = n(),
        shape1 = record_class$beta_1,
        shape2 = record_class$beta_2
      ),
      class = record_class$class,
      certain = record_class$certain,
      correct = runif(n()) < certainty
    )

  return(out)
}

build_dodo_records <- function(records, test_time, classes) {
  init_time <- 1

  certain_classes <- classes %>%
    filter(certain) %>%
    pull(class)

  uncertain_classes <- classes %>%
    filter(!certain) %>%
    pull(class)

  dodo_records <- list()

  dodo_records$init.time <- init_time
  dodo_records$test.time <- test_time
  dodo_records$threshold <- NA
  dodo_records$unique <- NA

  dodo_records$ccon <- records %>%
    filter(class %in% certain_classes) %>%
    pull(time) %>%
    sort()

  dodo_records$cbin <- as.integer(
    init_time:test_time %in% dodo_records$ccon
  )

  dodo_records$cdis <- factor(
    dodo_records$ccon,
    levels = init_time:test_time
  ) %>%
    table() %>%
    as.integer()

  dodo_records$ucon <- records %>%
    select(time, certainty) %>%
    arrange(time) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  dodo_records$ubin <- data.frame(
    certain = as.integer(
      init_time:test_time %in%
        (records %>%
          filter(class %in% certain_classes) %>%
          pull(time) %>%
          sort())
    ),
    uncertain = as.integer(
      init_time:test_time %in%
        (records %>%
          filter(class %in% uncertain_classes) %>%
          pull(time) %>%
          sort())
    )
  )

  umcb_list <- map(classes$class, function(class_i) {
    as.integer(
      init_time:test_time %in%
        (records %>%
          filter(class == class_i) %>%
          pull(time) %>%
          sort())
    )
  })

  names(umcb_list) <- paste0("records_", classes$class)

  dodo_records$umcb <- tibble(
    time = init_time:test_time,
    !!!umcb_list
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  dodo_records$iucn <- records %>%
    group_by(time) %>%
    arrange(desc(certainty), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      record = TRUE,
      certainty_lower = certainty,
      certainty_upper = certainty
    ) %>%
    right_join(
      tibble(time = init_time:test_time),
      by = "time"
    ) %>%
    select(time, record, certainty, certainty_lower, certainty_upper) %>%
    mutate(
      record = replace_na(record, FALSE),
      certainty = replace_na(certainty, 0),
      certainty_lower = replace_na(certainty_lower, 0),
      certainty_upper = replace_na(certainty_upper, 0)
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  dodo_records$LE14B1 <- records %>%
    select(time, class) %>%
    left_join(
      classes %>%
        transmute(
          class,
          certainty = beta_1 / (beta_1 + beta_2)
        ),
      by = "class"
    ) %>%
    arrange(time) %>%
    group_by(time) %>%
    arrange(desc(certainty), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      record = TRUE,
      certainty_lower = certainty,
      certainty_upper = certainty
    ) %>%
    right_join(
      tibble(time = init_time:test_time),
      by = "time"
    ) %>%
    select(time, record, certainty, certainty_lower, certainty_upper) %>%
    mutate(
      record = replace_na(record, FALSE),
      certainty = replace_na(certainty, 0),
      certainty_lower = replace_na(certainty_lower, 0),
      certainty_upper = replace_na(certainty_upper, 0)
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  return(dodo_records)
}

create_records <- function(extinction_time, pse, test_time, classes) {
  repeat {
    records <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(classes)), function(i) {
      simulate_class_records(
        record_class = classes[i, ],
        test_time = test_time,
        extinction_time = extinction_time,
        pse = pse
      )
    }) %>%
      arrange(time, class)

    dodo_records <- build_dodo_records(
      records = records,
      test_time = test_time,
      classes = classes
    )

    if (nrow(records) > 0 && length(dodo_records$ccon) > 0) break
  }

  return(list(
    raw = records,
    dodo = dodo_records
  ))
}

create_surveys <- function(test_time, epss, p_i, p_r) {
  surveys <- tibble(
    time = 1:test_time,
    survey = FALSE,
    epsilon = epss[1:test_time],
    epsilon_lower = epss[1:test_time],
    epsilon_upper = epss[1:test_time],
    p_i = p_i,
    p_i_lower = p_i,
    p_i_upper = p_i,
    p_r = p_r,
    p_r_lower = p_r,
    p_r_upper = p_r
  )

  return(surveys)
}

create_effort <- function(test_time, epss) {
  effort <- epss[1:test_time]

  return(effort)
}

Set up functions for models:

Code 
run_model <- function(model, records, surveys, effort, alpha, test_time) {
  out <- switch(model,
    "SL88F1" = SL88F1(records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha),
    "SS89F1" = SS89F1(records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha),
    "SS89B1" = SS89B1(
      records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha, length.out = 1e4,
      scale = 0.01
    ),
    "SO93F1" = SO93F1(
      records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "SO93B1" = SO93B1(
      records = records$dodo$ccon, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, pi = 0.5
    ),
    "SO93F2" = SO93F2(
      records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, precBits = 1024
    ),
    "MA94F1" = MA94F1(records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha, gamma = 0.5),
    "BU95F1" = BU95F1(records = records$dodo$cdis),
    "BU95F2" = BU95F2(records = records$dodo$cdis),
    "BU95F3" = BU95F3(records = records$dodo$cdis),
    "MA97F1" = MA97F1(
      records = records$dodo$cdis, effort = effort, alpha = alpha,
      init.time = 1
    ),
    "MC98F1" = MC98F1(records = records$dodo$cdis, effort = effort),
    "MC99F1" = MC99F1(
      records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "WM99B1" = WM99B1(
      records = records$dodo$cbin, surveys = 1:test_time,
      alpha = alpha, test.time = test_time, priors = list(
        lambda = 1e3, c = 1, d = 1
      ), increment = 0.01
    ),
    "RS03F1" = RS03F1(
      records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha,
      conf.int = "one-sided", k = ifelse(length(
        records$dodo$ccon
      ) >= 10, 10, length(records$dodo$ccon)),
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "SR03F1" = SR03F1(
      records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "MC06F1" = MC06F1(
      records = records$dodo$cbin, alpha = alpha,
      init.time = 1
    ),
    "RO09B1" = RO09B1(
      records = records$dodo$cbin, pi = 0.5, n.chains = 1,
      n.iter = 11e3, n.burnin = 1e3
    ),
    "JE10F1" = JE10F1(
      records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "JE10F2" = JE10F2(
      records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "BR12F1" = BR12F1(records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha),
    "SO12B1" = SO12B1(
      records = records$dodo$ubin, init.time = 1, increment = 0.001,
      gamma = 1, record.check = "error"
    ),
    "TH13B1" = TH13B1(
      records = records$dodo$umcb,
      priors = list(
        p = list(p1 = 0.5, p2 = 0.5, p3 = 0.5, p4 = 0.5),
        q = list(q1 = 1.0, q2 = 1.0, q3 = 0.5, q4 = 0.5)
      ),
      certain = c(1, 2), PXT = NULL, PE = NULL
    ),
    "TH13B2" = TH13B2(
      records = records$dodo$umcb,
      priors = list(
        p = list(p1 = c(0, 1), p2 = c(0, 1), p3 = c(0, 1), p4 = c(0, 1)),
        q = list(q1 = c(1, 1), q2 = c(1, 1), q3 = c(0, 1), q4 = c(0, 1))
      ),
      certain = c(1, 2), PXT = NULL, PE = NULL, n.iter = 10e3, pb = FALSE
    ),
    "TH13B3" = TH13B3(
      records = records$dodo$umcb,
      priors = list(
        p = list(p1 = c(0, 1), p2 = c(0, 1), p3 = c(0, 1), p4 = c(0, 1)),
        q = list(q1 = c(1, 1), q2 = c(1, 1), q3 = c(0, 1), q4 = c(0, 1))
      ),
      certain = c(1, 2), PXT = NULL, PE = NULL, n.iter = 10e3, pb = FALSE
    ),
    "AL14B1" = AL14B1(records = records$dodo$cbin),
    "CB14B1" = CB14B1(
      records = records$dodo$cbin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "CB14B2" = CB14B2(
      records = records$dodo$cbin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, burn.in = 1e3, n.iter = 11e3
    ),
    "JR14F1" = JR14F1(
      records = records$dodo$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "LE14B1" = LE14B1(
      records = records$dodo$LE14B1, surveys = surveys,
      threshold = 0.9, prior = c(0, 1), n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "LE14B2" = LE14B2(
      records = records$dodo$ubin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3, n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
    ),
    "SB14B1" = SB14B1(
      records = records$dodo$ubin, init.time = 1,
      increment = 0.001
    ),
    "SB14B2" = SB14B2(
      records = records$dodo$ubin, init.time = 1,
      increment = 0.001
    ),
    "AL15B1" = AL15B1(records = records$dodo$cbin),
    "SO16B1" = SO16B1(
      records = records$dodo$cbin, init.time = NULL,
      test.time = NULL, curr.time = NULL
    ),
    "SO16B2" = SO16B2(
      records = records$dodo$cbin, init.time = NULL,
      test.time = NULL, curr.time = NULL
    ),
    "WA16B1" = WA16B1(
      records = records$dodo$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      use.mpfr = FALSE, cores = 1, pb = FALSE
    ),
    "TH17I1" = TH17I1(records = records$dodo$iucn, surveys = surveys),
    "BR19F1" = BR19F1(
      records = records$dodo$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "BR19F2" = BR19F2(
      records = records$dodo$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "BR19F3" = BR19F3(
      records = records$dodo$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "BR19F4" = BR19F4(
      records = records$dodo$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "BR19F5" = BR19F5(
      records = records$dodo$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "TH19B1" = TH19B1(
      records = records$dodo$iucn, surveys = surveys,
      init.time = max(records$dodo$ccon) + 1, test.time = test_time,
      pi = 0.5
    ),
    "KO20B1" = KO20B1(
      records = records$dodo$cbin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3,
      n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
    ),
    "KO20B2" = KO20B2(
      records = records$dodo$ubin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3,
      n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
    ),
    "KO21B1" = KO21B1(
      records = records$dodo$ubin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3,
      n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
    ),
  )

  if (is.null(out)) {
    stop("Unknown model name: ", model)
  }

  return(out)
}

test_model <- function(model, output, alpha, test_time) {
  out <- switch(model,
    "SL88F1" = output$conf.int[2] < test_time,
    "SS89F1" = output$conf.int[2] < test_time,
    "SS89B1" = output$cred.int[2] < test_time,
    "SO93F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "SO93B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "SO93F2" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "MA94F1" = output$conf.int[3] < test_time,
    "BU95F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "BU95F2" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "BU95F3" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "MA97F1" = output$conf.int[2] < test_time,
    "MC98F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "MC99F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "WM99B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "RS03F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "SR03F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "MC06F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "RO09B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "JE10F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "JE10F2" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "BR12F1" = output$estimate < test_time,
    "SO12B1" = output$Bayes.factor > (1 / alpha),
    "TH13B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "TH13B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "TH13B3" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "AL14B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "CB14B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "CB14B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "JR14F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "LE14B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "LE14B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "SB14B1" = output$Bayes.factor > (1 / alpha),
    "SB14B2" = output$Bayes.factor > (1 / alpha),
    "AL15B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "SO16B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "SO16B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "WA16B1" = output$cred.int[2] < test_time,
    "TH17I1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F3" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F4" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F5" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "TH19B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "KO20B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "KO20B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "KO21B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
  )

  if (is.null(out)) {
    stop("Unknown model name: ", model)
  }

  return(out)
}

Set up output directory:

Code 
dir.create(file.path("Outputs", "D1", "Extant"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

Run

Generate datasets:

Code 
set.seed(1234)

rse_data <- grid %>%
  mutate(data = pmap(
    list(test_time, iteration),
    function(test_time, iteration) {
      records <- create_records(extinction_time, pse, test_time, classes)
      surveys <- create_surveys(test_time, epss, p_i, p_r)
      effort <- create_effort(test_time, epss)

      return(list(records = records, surveys = surveys, effort = effort))
    }
  ))

stopifnot(nrow(rse_data) == nrow(grid))
saveRDS(rse_data, "Outputs/D1/Extant/simulated_datasets.rds")

Run models:

Code 
if (file.exists("Outputs/D1/Extant/model_times.rds")) {
  model_times <- readRDS("Outputs/D1/Extant/model_times.rds")
} else {
  model_times <- tibble(
    model = character(), run_time = numeric(),
    end_time = POSIXct()
  )
}

for (model in models) {
  model_start <- Sys.time()
  model_ran <- FALSE

  model_file <- file.path("Outputs", "D1", "Extant", paste0(model, ".rds"))

  valid_file <- FALSE
  if (file.exists(model_file)) {
    check <- readRDS(model_file)
    if (!is.null(check$results) && nrow(check$results) == nrow(grid)) {
      valid_file <- TRUE
    }
    rm(check)
  }

  if (!valid_file || overwrite == TRUE) {
    model_ran <- TRUE

    results <- future_map(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(idx) {
      iteration <- grid$iteration[idx]
      test_time <- grid$test_time[idx]

      data_i <- rse_data$data[[idx]]

      iteration_start <- Sys.time()

      warning_msg <- character()
      error_msg <- NA_character_

      output <- tryCatch(
        withCallingHandlers(
          run_model(
            model = model, records = data_i$records,
            surveys = data_i$surveys, effort = data_i$effort,
            alpha = alpha, test_time = test_time
          ),
          warning = function(w) {
            warning_msg <<- c(warning_msg, conditionMessage(w))
            invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
          }
        ),
        error = function(e) {
          error_msg <<- conditionMessage(e)
          NULL
        }
      )

      i_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), iteration_start, units = "secs") %>%
        as.numeric()

      result <- if (is.null(output)) {
        tibble(
          model = model, iteration = iteration, test_time = test_time,
          isextinct = NA, warning = length(warning_msg) > 0, error = TRUE,
          warning_msg = if (length(warning_msg) > 0) {
            tbl <- table(warning_msg)
            paste0(names(tbl), " (x", as.integer(tbl), ")", collapse = " | ")
          } else {
            NA_character_
          },
          error_msg = if (length(error_msg) > 0) {
            tbl <- table(error_msg)
            paste0(names(tbl), " (x", as.integer(tbl), ")", collapse = " | ")
          } else {
            NA_character_
          }, run_time = i_time, end_time = Sys.time()
        )
      } else {
        tibble(
          model = model, iteration = iteration, test_time = test_time,
          isextinct = test_model(model, output, alpha, test_time),
          warning = length(warning_msg) > 0, error = FALSE,
          warning_msg = if (length(warning_msg) > 0) {
            tbl <- table(warning_msg)
            paste0(names(tbl), " (x", as.integer(tbl), ")", collapse = " | ")
          } else {
            NA_character_
          },
          error_msg = NA_character_, run_time = i_time, end_time = Sys.time()
        )
      }

      rm(output)
      gc()

      return(result)
    }, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))

    all_results <- bind_rows(results)

    saveRDS(list(model = model, results = all_results), model_file)
  }

  if (model_ran == TRUE) {
    m_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), model_start, units = "secs"))

    model_times <- model_times %>%
      filter(model != !!model) %>%
      bind_rows(tibble(
        model = model, run_time = m_time,
        end_time = Sys.time()
      ))
  }

  gc()
}

saveRDS(model_times, "Outputs/D1/Extant/model_times.rds")

Accuracy

Code 
models <- read_xlsx("Paper/EDE Papers.xlsx", sheet = 2, range = "D2:T50") %>%
  fill(everything(), .direction = "down") %>%
  pull(ID)

all_results <- all_results %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

results_summary <- all_results %>%
  group_by(model, test_time, isextinct) %>%
  tally() %>%
  group_by(model, test_time) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

predictions <- tibble(
  model = character(),
  test_time = integer(),
  lci = numeric(),
  fit = numeric(),
  uci = numeric()
)

excluded <- tibble(model = "AL14B2")

error_rates <- tibble(
  model = character(),
  mean_error_rate = numeric(),
  slope = numeric()
)

for (model_i in unique(all_results$model)) {
  estimates <- all_results %>%
    filter(model == model_i)

  if (mean(is.na(estimates$isextinct)) >= 0.5) {
    prediction_i <- data.frame(
      model = model_i,
      test_time = min(test_times):max(test_times),
      lci = NA,
      fit = NA,
      uci = NA
    )

    error_rate_i <- tibble(
      model = model_i,
      mean_error_rate = NA,
      slope = NA
    )

    predictions <- bind_rows(predictions, prediction_i)

    error_rates <- bind_rows(error_rates, error_rate_i)

    excluded <- bind_rows(excluded, tibble(model = model_i))

    next
  }

  accuracy_model_i <- glm(
    data = estimates,
    formula = isextinct ~ test_time,
    family = "binomial"
  )

  prediction_i <- predict(accuracy_model_i, newdata = data.frame(
    test_time = min(test_times):max(test_times)
  ), se.fit = TRUE) %>%
    bind_cols(data.frame(test_time = min(test_times):max(test_times)), .) %>%
    mutate(
      lci = plogis(fit + qnorm(0.025) * se.fit),
      uci = plogis(fit + qnorm(0.975) * se.fit),
      fit = plogis(fit),
      model = model_i
    ) %>%
    select(model, test_time, lci, fit, uci)

  error_rate_i <- tibble(
    model = model_i,
    mean_error_rate = mean(prediction_i$fit),
    slope = accuracy_model_i$coefficients["test_time"]
  )

  predictions <- bind_rows(predictions, prediction_i)

  error_rates <- bind_rows(error_rates, error_rate_i)
}

excluded <- excluded %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

predictions <- predictions %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

error_rates <- error_rates %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

saveRDS(error_rates, "Outputs/D1/Extant/error_rates.rds")

accuracy_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = predictions,
    aes(x = test_time, ymin = lci, ymax = uci),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = predictions,
    aes(x = test_time, y = fit),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = results_summary,
    aes(x = test_time, y = isextinct, size = prop)
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = excluded,
    label = "Excluded", x = (max(test_times) + min(test_times)) / 2,
    y = 0.5, fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(family = "mono", face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Duration of Sighting Record",
    y = "Estimated Type I Error Rate"
  )
